battle.name: 幫源洞之戰
battle.brief: 宣和三年（1121）四月，宋宣撫使童貫、宣撫司都統制劉延慶率京師禁軍與六路漢蕃精兵十五萬南下平方臘。二十四日，統制劉鎮率勁兵間道掩擊門嶺，鳴鏑縱火，焚燒幫源洞口義軍廬舍；王稟自洞前望煙而進，兩軍夾擊，義軍七萬餘人被斬。二十六日，韓世忠潛行溪谷，搗巢擒方臘。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 幫源洞之戰的交戰雙方，是北宋朝廷的平叛軍與方臘的明教義軍。宋方由江浙、淮南等路宣撫使童貫總其事的宣撫司率領，統制劉延慶為宣撫司都統制，所部為京師禁軍，加上熙河、涇原、環慶、鄜延、秦鳳、河東六路漢蕃精兵，號十五萬；旗下統制王稟、劉鎮各當一面，統制官楊惟忠、忠州防禦使辛興宗等分將其事，命令自宣撫司下達，各軍自徵轉運，糧秣就江浙漕運與州縣徵發，兵多步卒，舟車並用。地方上，睦州、歙州、杭州、婺州各州縣與保甲鄉兵接應，弓箭社一類的民兵亦在編。義軍一方是鬆散而龐大的起義政權：首領方臘為雇工出身，以明教傳教聚眾，自號聖公，年號永樂，以巾飾為記號，自紅巾以上分為六等；旗下有蘭溪朱顏、吳邦，剡縣仇道人，仙居呂師囊，方巖山陳十四，蘇州石生，歸安陸行兒等首領，曾攻下睦州、杭州、婺州、歙州等州縣，政權橫跨蘇浙皖贛四省六州五十二縣。兩軍對峙之地是睦州青溪縣的幫源洞，在今浙江淳安縣西北的山區峽谷，北控建德（睦州治），南通杭州，東接徽歙，是兩浙邊陲的一處險要。
countriesEn: The two sides in the battle of Aidingyuan were the punitive army of the Northern Song and the Mingjiao insurgents of Fang La. On the Song side the command lay with the expedition commission headed by Tong Guan, commissioner for the circuits of Jiangzhe, Huainan and others, with Liu Yanqing as commander-in-chief of the commission; his force was the guards of the capital together with the picked Chinese and native troops of six circuits, Xining, Jingyuan, Huanqing, Fuyan, Qinfeng and Hedong, proclaimed at one hundred and fifty thousand men. Under them the commanders Wang Bao and Liu Zhen each took a side, with the commanders Yang Weizhong and Xin Xingzong, defender of Zhongzhou, holding separate commands; the orders came down from the commission, every army collected its own transport, and grain came from the waterways of Jiangzhe and from requisitions upon the prefectures and counties. The soldiers were foot in the main, and boats and carts were used as well. On the local side the prefectures and counties of Muzhou, Shezhou, Hangzhou and Wuzhou, with the baojia militia and the local archers, supported the campaign. On the other side was a loose but enormous rebel state: Fang La, a hired labourer by origin, had gathered a following through the teaching of Mingjiao, called himself the Sage Lord, took the era name of Yongle, used the head-cloth as a badge, and divided his followers into six ranks from the red scarf upward. Under him stood chiefs such as Zhu Yan and Wu Bang of Lanxi, Qiu Daoren of Shan, Lü Shixang of Xianju, Chen Shisi of Fangyan, Shi Sheng of Suzhou and Lu Xing'er of Gui'an; they had carried the prefectures of Muzhou, Hangzhou, Wuzhou and Shezhou, and the polity they had built reached across four provinces of Suzhou, Zhejiang, Anhui and Jiangxi, six prefectures and fifty-two counties. The ground on which the two armies met was the cave of Aidingyuan in the district of Qingxi in Muzhou, in the ravines of the mountains north-west of today's Chun'an in Zhejiang: it commands Jiande, the seat of Muzhou, to the north, lies on the road to Hangzhou to the south, and touches the She and Hui region to the east, and it is a strong position on the edge of the two Zhejiang circuits.
people: 宋方主持者是童貫，這位以宦官領兵的宣撫使把北伐大軍原封不動調了過來——原擬北伐的十五萬人，轉眼南下平叛；都統制劉延慶是前一年統兵北上的同一員將，統制王稟以婺州觀察使、侍衛親軍步軍司都虞侯領一軍負責睦州方向，統制劉鎮當歙州方向，兩軍約期會於睦州、歙州之間合圍洞口。真正決定戰局的另有二人：一是劉鎮，他率勁兵間道掩擊門嶺，突破扼守險徑崖壁的義軍阻截，且戰且進，鳴鏑縱火，才焚得動洞口的廬舍；二是當時還只是武階從九品的小官韓世忠，他隨王稟軍至杭州，又追至睦州清溪洞，見義軍探據嚴崖為三窟，諸將追至無從下手，便潛行溪谷，問野婦得洞口，挺身仗戈而前，越險數里，搗其巢穴，格殺數人而擒出方臘。首級本應賞授兩鎮節度使，忠州防禦使、統制官辛興宗卻領兵截在洞口，把擒獲之功攬去；統制官楊惟忠回闕上表其事，韓世忠才超授承節郎。義軍方面，聖公方臘自號永樂，勢力最盛時雄踞六州五十二縣，諸首領各領一隅。事後《水滸傳》把此役寫成梁山一百單八將的功業，說陣亡五十九人、擒方臘者為魯智深；民間傳說與影視改編則把榮譽給了獨臂武松。
peopleEn: The man in charge on the Song side was Tong Guan, the eunuch who led armies and who now brought his expedition commission with him: the very host of one hundred and fifty thousand that had been raised to invade the north was turned round and sent south to put down the rebellion. The commander-in-chief of the commission, Liu Yanqing, was the same officer who had led the northern host the year before. The commander Wang Bao, who as observer of Wuzhou and deputy commander of the infantry of the palace guards led the army on the Muzhou side, and the commander Liu Zhen took the Shezhou side; the two agreed to meet between Muzhou and Shezhou and close the net round the mouth of the cave. Two others in fact decided the battle. The first was Liu Zhen, who led picked troops by hidden paths onto the pass of Menling, broke through the insurgents who held the cliff path, fought forward as he went, and sent whistling arrows and fire, and only so could he burn the huts at the mouth of the cave. The second was Han Shizhong, then only a junior officer of the ninth rank: he followed Wang Bao's army to Hangzhou and pursued to the cave of Qingxi in Muzhou, where the insurgents had posted a lookout on the sheer cliff with three caves, so that the other commanders, arriving at the place, could not tell which way to go in; he then went by hidden paths through the stream valleys, asked a country woman for the entrance, took his halberd and went forward alone, climbed through the thorns and the broken ridges for several li, struck into the nest, killed several men and brought Fang La out. The head was worth two military governorship by the terms of the edict, yet the defender of Zhongzhou and commander Xin Xingzong had led men to the entrance and taken the capture for his own credit; it was the commander Yang Weizhong, reporting to the court, who had the matter put right, and Han Shizhong was then advanced over his rank to a gentleman of the Chengjie grade. On the rebel side, Fang La, the Sage Lord of the Yongle era, held at his greatest extent six prefectures and fifty-two counties, each of the chiefs commanding his own corner. Afterwards the Water Margin turned the campaign into the achievement of the hundred and eight heroes of Liangshan, saying that fifty-nine of them fell there and that it was Lu Zhishen who took Fang La; the folk legend and the later screen adaptations gave the honour instead to the one-armed Wu Song.
kits: 本卡的兵器是希臘火——拜占庭帝國在七世紀配在銅管裡的燃燒劑，配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。它並不在幫源洞的戰場上：那裡沒有銅管噴射器，也沒有裝著希臘火的戰船；宋軍用來火攻的是火箭、火炬與浸油之物。但兩者屬於同一條技術路線的核心——以油、硫、硝為主藥的燃燒劑，靠投射器或火炬送到目標上，命中即起黏著之火，撲滅不易。幫源洞之役的燃燒劑記在《續資治通鑒》的一句「鳴鏑縱火」裡：火矢以火藥附於箭鏃，弓弩發射後引信續燃，飛越險徑落在義軍茅草木構的廬舍上；火炬與火油則供近身清障。火在此役兼有兩重身分：先是信號，兩軍約定以縱火為號，前後夾擊；後是武器，燒掉洞口寨屋，令守軍失去依托、視線大亂，也令進攻隊得到煙幕與混亂的掩護——義軍的寨屋多以竹木茅草構成，正是最怕火的東西。宋軍的攻城器械另有雲梯、攻城砲與火藥兵器，軍需靠舟車由江南漕運轉輸，十五萬眾以步卒為主，騎兵有限；義軍則以刀矛弓箭作戰，恃柴草廬舍、竹木拒馬與崖壁險徑設卡，洞口巖穴為三窟，糧秣只靠屯聚與劫掠，無攻城之器。真正的希臘火同年卻在別處開火：拜占庭皇帝約翰二世於1121年再入敘利亞，拔貝魯特、進逼阿勒頗，以火攻配合圍城器械攻塞爾柱人的城塞——那才是這件兵器真正出鞘的地方。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is Greek fire, the burning mixture of the Byzantine empire in the seventh century, served in a copper tube; the formula was the secret of the empire, and the formula and the ship went down together. It was not on the field at Aidingyuan: there was no copper tube there and no war galley loaded with Greek fire. What the Song used for fire was fire arrows, torches and oil-soaked brands. Yet both belong to the heart of one line of technology — a burning charge made chiefly of oil, sulphur and saltpetre, carried to its target by a thrower or a torch, taking hold at once and clinging to what it struck, hard to put out. The burning charge of this campaign is in the phrase of the Xu Zizhi Tongjian about the whistling arrows and the fire: the fire arrow carried a charge of gunpowder at the head, the bow or crossbow sent it out and the fuse burned on in flight, and it fell over the cliff path onto the huts of the insurgents, which were built of thatch, timber and brushwood; torches and oil served for clearing the ground at close quarters. Fire had a double character in this battle. First it was a signal: the two columns had agreed to make the advance on the signal of the fire, closing in from the front and the rear together. Then it was a weapon: burning the huts at the mouth of the cave robbed the defenders of their cover, filled their sight with smoke and confusion, and gave the attacking troops both a screen and the cover of that confusion — for the huts of the insurgents were made of bamboo, wood and thatch, and those are the things that fear fire most. The Song siege train had scaling ladders, stone-throwing engines and gunpowder weapons besides; the supplies came up by boat and cart over the waterways of Jiangnan, and of the one hundred and fifty thousand men the foot were the greater part, the horse being few. The insurgents fought with knives, spears and bows, relying on thatched huts, wooden barriers and checkpoints along the cliff path; the mouth of the cave was made of three rocky chambers, their grain depended on what they had gathered and taken, and they had no engine of assault at all. The true Greek fire was busy elsewhere in the same year: in 1121 the Byzantine emperor John II re-entered Syria, took Beirut and pressed toward Aleppo, and attacked the Seljuk fortresses with fire and with the engines of the siege — and that was where this weapon truly came out of its sheath.
tactics: 宋軍的打法是典型的宋代平叛攻山：宣撫司統一調度，兵分兩路貼近洞口，王稟自睦州方向收復州縣、進至洞前，劉鎮自歙州方向收復州縣、駐軍洞後，約定從洞後突入、縱火為號、前後夾擊，把義軍的退路與進路同時掐斷。門嶺一段是最難啃的骨頭：崖壁險徑為義軍扼守，正面強攻只會撞在石壁與木柵上，劉鎮遂分勁兵間道掩擊，繞行攀援，且戰且進，突破阻截後立刻以火箭火炬焚燒沿途寨屋，火勢自下而上蔓延，洞口守軍被煙火逼迫失去陣位；王稟在洞前望見煙起，率軍直入，兩軍內外合擊，義軍腹背受敵，奮力轉戰仍潰，屍首蔽野。火在這一役並非裝飾：它同時是進攻的時間表、是清理木寨的手段、也是士氣的崩解劑。義軍方面的部署則是老問題——依險固守，洞口巖穴分為三窟，險徑設卡，糧秣靠屯聚與徵糧；兵一旦潰散，四散入山，全國的抵抗便拖成游擊式的持久戰。另一層值得記錄的問題在獎賞：詔許得方臘首者授兩鎮節度使，於是斬首與掠功的誘因並存，辛興宗截洞口奪功，正是這套激勵機制在戰場上的樣子。
tacticsEn: The Song plan was the classic Song way of taking a rebel stronghold in the hills. The expedition commission directed everything, the army was split into two columns that closed in upon the mouth of the cave, Wang Bao recovering the prefectures on the Muzhou side and coming up to the front of the cave, Liu Zhen recovering the prefectures on the Shezhou side and posting himself behind it; the two agreed to break in from the rear, to make the advance on the signal of the fire, and to close in from both ends, so as to cut off the insurgents' road out and their road in at the same time. The stretch at Menling was the hardest bone to pick: the cliff path was held by the insurgents, and a frontal assault would only break against rock and wooden fences, so Liu Zhen detached picked troops to come by hidden paths, to climb round, to fight forward as they went, and the moment they had broken through the cordon they set fire with arrows and torches to the huts along the way; the fire ran up from below, the defenders at the mouth were pressed by the smoke and lost their positions, and Wang Bao, seeing the smoke rise from the front of the cave, led his men straight in, the two columns closing from within and without; the insurgents were attacked in front and rear, fought with all their strength and broke all the same, and the field was covered with the dead. Fire in this battle was no ornament: it was at once the timetable of the assault, the means of clearing the wooden stockades, and the dissolver of morale. The rebels' own plan was the old problem: to hold the strong ground, with the mouth of the cave split into three rocky chambers, checkpoints on the cliff path, and grain dependent on what was stored and what could be taken. Once the army broke it scattered into the hills, and the resistance of the whole region turned into a long guerrilla war. A second feature of the day deserves recording, and it lies in the reward: the edict promised two military governorships to whoever brought the head of Fang La, so the incentive to cut off the head and the incentive to steal the credit stood side by side, and Xin Xingzong standing at the entrance to claim the capture is exactly what that system of reward looked like on the field.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間：宣和三年（1121）正月十九日童貫等進抵鎮江，控制金陵與揚子江口，集兵收復杭州；四月王稟收復睦州、將至洞前，劉鎮等收復歙州、駐軍洞後；四月二十四日劉鎮等突破門嶺、縱火焚燒廬舍，同日兩軍合圍，義軍被斬七萬餘人；四月二十六日方臘被擒，餘眾散據各地，戰事延續至翌年方定。兵力：宣撫司所部為京師禁軍加熙河、涇原、環慶、鄜延、秦鳳、河東六路漢蕃精兵，號十五萬；義軍退據幫源洞時集兵二十萬，方臘一度控制的政權橫跨蘇浙皖贛四省六州五十二縣。距離：幫源洞在睦州青溪縣（今浙江淳安縣西北），距睦州治建德約數十里山路，距歙州稍遠，自杭州至此須經建德、淳安的山道，舟車不能直入，糧秣全賴後方轉輸。官階與賞格：詔許得方臘首者授兩鎮節度使；實際執行中辛興宗截洞口掠功，楊惟忠表其事，韓世忠超授承節郎（武階五十一階，從九品）。演義與傳說的數字另計：《水滸傳》說梁山一百單八將此役陣亡五十九人，擒方臘者為魯智深；此類數字屬小說家言，不可以當史乘。旁證：同年拜占庭皇帝約翰二世再入敘利亞，拔貝魯特、進逼阿勒頗。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time: on the nineteenth day of the first month of Xuanhe 3 (1121) Tong Guan and the rest reached Zhenjiang, took control of the capital of the south and of the mouth of the Yangzi, and massed their troops to retake Hangzhou; in the fourth month Wang Bao recovered Muzhou and came up to the front of the cave, while Liu Zhen and the rest recovered Shezhou and posted themselves behind it; on the twenty-fourth day of the fourth month Liu Zhen and the rest broke through Menling and set fire to the huts, and the same day the two columns closed and seven tens of thousands of the insurgents were killed; on the twenty-sixth day Fang La was taken, the survivors scattered over the country, and the war dragged on into the following year before it was settled. In strength: the commission commanded the guards of the capital together with the picked Chinese and native troops of the six circuits of Xining, Jingyuan, Huanqing, Fuyan, Qinfeng and Hedong, proclaimed at one hundred and fifty thousand; the insurgents mustered two hundred thousand when they fell back on Aidingyuan, and the polity Fang La controlled at one point reached across four provinces, Suzhou, Zhejiang, Anhui and Jiangxi, six prefectures and fifty-two counties. In distance: the cave lay in the district of Qingxi in Muzhou, in the north-west of today's Chun'an in Zhejiang, some tens of li of mountain road from the seat of Muzhou at Jiande and further from Shezhou; the road from Hangzhou ran through the passes of Jiande and Chun'an, boats and carts could not go straight in, and the grain came entirely from the rear. In rank and reward: the edict promised two military governorships to whoever brought the head of Fang La; in the actual execution Xin Xingzong stood at the entrance and took the credit, Yang Weizhong reported the business, and Han Shizhong was advanced to the grade of Chengjie, the fifty-first step of the military ranks and the ninth of the lower grade. The figures of the novel and the legend are counted apart: the Water Margin says that fifty-nine of the hundred and eight heroes of Liangshan fell in this campaign and that Lu Zhishen took Fang La; such numbers belong to the story-teller and cannot be treated as history. For corroboration: in the same year the Byzantine emperor John II re-entered Syria, took Beirut and pressed toward Aleppo.
cause: 打起嚟的緣由是兩浙的民變積累到爆發。宣和年間宋廷奢侈，江南承受花石綱的徵斂，歲幣又奉於遼夏，民間怨望已久；明教在江浙傳播，窮苦農民多有信之，雇工出身的方臘有組織力，替他聚眾。宣和二年（1120）十月，方臘率眾起事，一說在歙縣七賢村，一說就在淳安縣萬年鄉的清溪幫源洞；他於漆園誓師，自號聖公，年號永樂，以巾飾為記號，自紅巾以上分為六等，分兵四出，蘭溪朱顏、吳邦，剡縣仇道人，仙居呂師囊，方巖山陳十四，蘇州石生，歸安陸行兒等先後響應，數月之間連下睦州、杭州、婺州、歙州等地，一度控制六州五十二縣，東南震動。宋廷初命地方討捕，婺州觀察使王稟受命往討，但兵力不敷、戰局蔓延，義軍退守幫源洞，憑險固守，把總戰場收攏到睦州青溪那一片山區。宣和三年正月，宋廷作出關鍵決定：暫停北伐，把原擬北上的軍隊調頭南下，命童貫為江浙、淮南等路宣撫使，劉延慶充宣撫司都統制，率十五萬眾東南下來平叛。官軍也正是要在那裡完成最後一役。
causeEn: The war came out of the accumulation of grievance in the two Zhejiang circuits until it burst. In the years of Xuanhe the court of Song was extravagant, the south of the Yangzi bore the levies of the curious stones and fine things, the annual payments went to the Liao and the Western Xia, and the resentment in the country had been long standing; Mingjiao was spreading through Jiangzhe, and the poor followed it, and Fang La, a hired labourer by origin, had the organising ability to gather them for himself. In the tenth month of Xuanhe 2 (1120) Fang La rose with his followers, in one account at the village of Qixian in She County, in another at the cave of Qingxi, Aidingyuan, in the Wannian district of today's Chun'an; he swore his men in the lacquer grove, called himself the Sage Lord, took the era name of Yongle, made the head-cloth his badge, divided his followers into six ranks from the red scarf upward, and sent his columns out in all directions; Zhu Yan and Wu Bang of Lanxi, Qiu Daoren of Shan, Lü Shixang of Xianju, Chen Shisi of Fangyan, Shi Sheng of Suzhou and Lu Xing'er of Gui'an answered the call in turn, and within a few months the prefectures of Muzhou, Hangzhou, Wuzhou and Shezhou fell, six prefectures and fifty-two counties came under control for a time, and the whole south-east was shaken. The court at first ordered the local authorities to put it down, and Wang Bao, observer of Wuzhou, was sent against it, but the troops were not enough and the fighting spread; the insurgents fell back on Aidingyuan and held the strong ground, drawing the whole theatre of the war into the mountains of Qingxi in Muzhou. In the first month of Xuanhe 3 the court made the decisive choice: the northern expedition was suspended, the army raised to march north was turned round and sent south, Tong Guan was made commissioner for the circuits of Jiangzhe, Huainan and others, Liu Yanqing was made commander-in-chief of the expedition commission, and one hundred and fifty thousand men were marched east and south to put the rebellion down. Aidingyuan was where the government army meant to finish it.
impact: 此役是北宋末年一次真正的平亂，也是江南由亂返治的轉捩點。幫源洞一破，方臘政權的骨架散了，睦州、杭州、婺州、歙州等州縣次第收復，被徵發的花石綱與雜斂得以停止，兩浙的生產與漕運重新接上，東南在靖康之前得了一段相對安定的時間。代價卻也記在史冊：宣撫司大軍深入兩浙，徵發、括糧、掠取與隨軍廚竈所耗，都是從州縣百姓頭上出，軍紀敗壞之後，殘餘義軍散入山澤，抵抗反而拖到翌年；得首賞格的制度也留下隱患，奪功之風自此在軍中更盛。日後回看，這一役真正改變的，是北宋的戰略節奏：原定北伐的大軍被硬生生拖回江南一年有餘，等到宣和四年再議北伐，士氣與財政都已不是原樣，最終收燕不成，反引金兵直下。對武器史而言，幫源洞留下的是十二世紀初火攻的兩個標準用法：以火作信號統一多路兵馬的同時進攻，以火燒清木構寨屋、破壞守軍依托——這正是燃燒兵器在任何城寨攻防裡的內核，而真正的希臘火同年正在敘利亞的城塞前大展身手，兩條相隔萬里的技術路線在同一個年份上並肩而行。
impactEn: This campaign was a real pacification at the end of the Northern Song and the turning point at which the south of the Yangzi came back under orderly rule. Once Aidingyuan fell the frame of Fang La's polity fell apart, the prefectures of Muzhou, Hangzhou, Wuzhou and Shezhou were recovered one by one, the levies of the curious stones and the other exactions were stopped, the production and the grain traffic of the two Zhejiang circuits were joined up again, and the south-east had a stretch of relative quiet before the disaster of Jingkang. The price is written down as well. The great army of the commission pushed deep into the two Zhejiang circuits, and the requisitions, the seizures of grain, the plunder and the cooking of the column's messes were all taken from the people of the prefectures and counties; and once the discipline of the army had broken down, the remnants scattered into the hills and the resistance dragged on into the next year. The system of reward for the head left its own hidden danger, and the appetite for stolen credit grew worse in the army from then on. Seen afterwards, what this campaign truly changed was the rhythm of Song strategy: the host raised for the northern expedition was dragged back into the south for the best part of a year, and when the northern expedition was debated again in Xuanhe 4 the morale and the finances were no longer what they had been; the recovery of You and Yun came to nothing, and instead the Jin came straight down. For the history of weapons, Aidingyuan sets down the two standard uses of fire in the early twelfth century: fire as the signal that synchronises the advance of several columns, and fire to burn clear the wooden stockades and destroy the cover of the defenders. That is the core of the burning weapon in any assault on a stockade, and in the very same year the true Greek fire was doing its work before the fortresses of Syria, so that two lines of technology thousands of miles apart ran side by side in a single year.
result: 四月二十四日，劉鎮等突破門嶺、鳴鏑縱火、焚燒義軍廬舍，王稟望煙而進，兩軍內外合擊，義軍腹背遭攻，奮力轉戰仍大潰，被斬七萬餘人，屍首蔽野。四月二十六日，韓世忠潛行溪谷、問野婦得洞口、越險數里、搗其巢穴，格殺數人而擒出方臘，檻送汴京，同年十月間伏誅，其妻邵氏與子亳亦被收執。餘眾散據各地，繼續抵抗，官軍分路搜剿，直至翌年方臘之亂始平。首級的歸屬留下瑕疵：詔有得方臘首者授兩鎮節度使之賞，辛興宗領兵截在洞口，掠以為功，經統制官楊惟忠表奏，才為韓世忠爭得超授承節郎。史筆與演義在此處分叉：《水滸傳》將此役寫成梁山一百單八將的功業，說梁山兵將多陣亡於此、擒方臘者為魯智深；民間傳說與後來的影視改編則讓獨臂武松擒方臘。就本卡兵器而言，這一役沒有希臘火參與，但它把燃燒兵器的兩個要訣留了下來：火要先送到木寨頂上才燒得動，火也要能讓遠處的隊伍同時看懂進攻的時刻。
resultEn: On the twenty-fourth day of the fourth month Liu Zhen and the rest broke through Menling, sent whistling arrows and fire, and burned the huts of the insurgents; Wang Bao, seeing the smoke, came in from the front of the cave, the two columns closed from within and without, the insurgents were taken in front and rear, fought with everything they had and were broken all the same, and seven tens of thousands of them were killed, the field covered with the dead. On the twenty-sixth day Han Shizhong went by hidden paths through the stream valleys, asked a country woman for the entrance, climbed through the broken ridges for several li, struck into the nest, killed several men and brought Fang La out; he was sent to the capital in a cage and executed in the tenth month of that year, and his wife Shao and his son Bo were taken with him. The survivors scattered over the country and kept on resisting, and the government troops hunted them down by columns until the rebellion of Fang La was finally settled in the year following. The ownership of the head left a blemish: the edict had promised two military governorships to whoever brought the head of Fang La, and Xin Xingzong had led men to the entrance and claimed the capture as his own; only when the commander Yang Weizhong reported to the court was the matter set right, and Han Shizhong gained his advancement to the grade of Chengjie. Here the historical record and the tale part company. The Water Margin turned the campaign into the achievement of the hundred and eight heroes of Liangshan, saying that many of the Liangshan warriors fell there and that Lu Zhishen took Fang La; the folk legend and the later screen adaptations gave the capture to the one-armed Wu Song. As for the weapon on this card, Greek fire took no part in this battle, and yet the battle left behind the two rules of the burning weapon: the fire must be carried to the top of the wooden stockade before it can do its work, and the fire must be visible enough for columns far off to read the moment of the advance.
